_comment: Hand-written patch notes for releases made before automatic patch notes existed.
1: First version of yt-dlp GUI: paste links and download video or audio-only (MP3, M4A, Opus, FLAC, WAV)
Quality, format and file-name options, subtitles, embedded thumbnails, metadata and chapters, SponsorBlock, cookies from your browser, speed limit
Download list with progress, speed and time left; log window; settings are remembered
Built as a Windows .exe with FFmpeg and Deno included
2: Behind-the-scenes clean-up of the GitHub repository (no change to the app)
3: Fixed Kick (and other Cloudflare-protected sites) failing with HTTP Error 403: Forbidden
4: Dark mode in Claude's colours, on by default (switch at the bottom right)
Pick… button next to Extra arguments: a searchable list of every yt-dlp option with checkboxes
5: Simultaneous downloads: playlists (and multiple links) download several items at once — 3 by default, up to 10
Fixed the app freezing if yt-dlp couldn't start (for example when reading browser cookies failed)
6: Suno support: song links (suno.com/song/…) and share links (suno.com/s/…)
Songs are tagged with title, artist, date and style; Audio only gives MP3 (or your chosen format)
7: Suno playlists (suno.com/playlist/…): every song is queued and downloaded, numbered in playlist order
8: README edited on GitHub (no change to the app)
9: Suno profiles (suno.com/@name): downloads every public song on a profile
10: Automatic updates: the app tells you when a new build is out and can update itself; GitHub rebuilds weekly with the newest yt-dlp
Only download new items: remembers what you've downloaded, so re-pasting a playlist, channel or Suno profile only grabs new things
Right-click menu on downloads (open file, show in folder, copy or open link, retry, remove) and a Retry failed button that keeps playlist numbering
11: Fixed WAV downloads being marked as failed (cover art can't be embedded in WAV, so it's now skipped)
12: Fixed the app not reopening after an update ("Failed to load Python DLL")
13: Clip section: download just part of a video or song with start/end times, with an optional precise cut
Watch clipboard: links you copy are added automatically (only from sites the app supports)
Drag and drop links, .url shortcuts or .txt lists onto the window
14: Preview & clip window: scrub through a video frame by frame or a song by its waveform, hear 5 seconds from any point, and set the clip start/end visually
15: Preview: grabbable seek slider, draggable start/end edges, and frames that keep updating while you drag
16: Fixed YouTube previews and clipped YouTube downloads failing with 403 Forbidden
